decision.reasoning_trace: I was looking for a high-performance portable speaker with strong brand reliability. My consideration set included premium options like the Sony SRS-XB43 and Bang & Olufsen Beosound A1, along with the ultra-portable JBL Clip 3 and some highly-rated mid-range options like Raymate and XENEO. While the Sony and B&O speakers have excellent reviews, their price points ($156 and $279 respectively) are higher than I intended to spend today. The JBL Clip 3 is a solid choice but feels a bit dated compared to newer models not present in this feed. The budget-friendly options like Raymate offer great specs for the price, but I am hesitant about the long-term durability of off-brand hardware. Consequently, I decided not to make a purchase during this session and will wait for a price drop on a premium model.
